articles.headline: Aaron Ramsey's Oxford briefly down to eight players, salvage a draw
articles.description: Oxford boss Aaron Ramsey was proud of his side's battling spirit as they hung on for a 1-1 draw at Mansfield with nine men after two red cards in the last 15 minutes.

articles.headline: Racism allegation mars Swansea win at Millwall
articles.description: Substitute Ronald scored a last-minute winner to keep Swansea top of the Championship after their match at Millwall was held up due to alleged racist chanting aimed at the visitors' Eom Ji-sung.
